batches.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: transparent 3 by 3 sprite atlas for a square profile-picture generator. Rework the attached atlas into EXACTLY NINE NEW distinct looks in an evenly spaced 3-column by 3-row square grid. Preserve the reference's premium pixel-art anime medium EXACTLY: wide glossy warm-brown eyes, warm friendly adult woman face, detailed golden hair with darker gold shadows, finely dithered highlights, deliberate pixel edges and textured violet fabric. Do not switch to smooth vector, 3D, painterly, realistic photography or coarse 8-bit art.
Canvas: square, preferably 1536 by 1536 with each tile 512 by 512. Genuine alpha transparency behind every character. No drawn checkerboard, no background, no grid lines, no labels, no shadows outside character. Each of the 9 cells is an independent front-view waist-up portrait. Same overall framing and scale as reference. In each cell head and all hats fully visible with a little margin, face centered around x256 y240, clothing torso reaches the cell's bottom edge. Keep all hair and accessories within their own cell with side margin, no overlap between cells.
CRITICAL SOURCE COLORS: every character has GOLDEN YELLOW/BLONDE hair ONLY, including the sidecut; every outfit, hat and headphones is VIOLET/PURPLE fabric with neutral white/gray detailing only. Hair colors will be changed by software later. Skin stays warm PEACH. Large clean white uppercase text exactly "AGI" (A-G-I) is centered on EVERY character's chest, unobstructed and readable; no other lettering. Place braids/hair to sides of that chest text.
Nine cells in strict row-major order:
Top row left: neat chin-length bob with a soft violet beret tilted slightly, violet crewneck sweater, knowing gentle smile.
Top row center: shoulder-length loose waves under a violet newsboy cap, violet collared overshirt open over an AGI tee, cheerful mouth slightly open.
Top row right: two low braids with violet cat-ear headphones (headphones only, no animal), violet hoodie, small excited smile.
Middle row left: short pixie haircut inside a raised violet hoodie hood, gold bangs visible, calm confident face.
Middle row center: shoulder-length flipped-out hair with no hat, violet sweater with a distinct white sailor collar, sweet neutral smile.
Middle row right: medium layered hair, violet soft fur-trimmed winter hat and violet puffer jacket open to reveal the AGI shirt, cozy smile.
Bottom row left: high messy bun, delicate round silver glasses with transparent lenses showing both wide eyes, violet sweatshirt, attentive expression.
Bottom row center: modern short sidecut with long side-swept bangs and violet snapback perched backward, violet streetwear jacket over AGI tee, playful confident smile.
Bottom row right: intricate crown braid around the head with loose wavy shoulder-length ends, violet knit sweater, serene smile.
Only those nine human portraits. No animals, companions, props held in hands, scenery, captions or watermarks. Keep all nine visually cohesive with the reference; fully transparent empty margins.
batches.spacingPrompt:
Asset-edit task: Keep these EXACT same nine distinct characters and outfits in the EXACT same row-major order. Preserve the art style, golden hair, violet clothes, peach skin, faces, accessories and clearly readable white chest text "AGI". Change ONLY the atlas spacing and composition to make each sprite fully isolated and machine-croppable.
Output a square transparent sprite sheet with a mathematically regular THREE BY THREE grid of equal square cells. In EACH cell shrink and center its one character so the complete hair, hat, shoulders and chest are visible, with a WIDE EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN on all four sides. Every sprite occupies at most 80 percent of the width and 82 percent of the height of its cell. All nine busts have a straight horizontal cut at the bottom of their clothing, ABOVE the bottom of the cell. There must be a broad transparent horizontal gutter between rows and a broad transparent vertical gutter between columns. NO character touches another, no pixels cross between cells, none touches the canvas edge. Do not connect bodies or overlap strands. Top and side margins around every silhouette are compulsory. No background, no visible grid, no captions, no checkerboard. All nine remain as complete front-facing head-and-torso portraits with readable AGI. True alpha transparency.
